name: The Marker: Golf Scorecard
subtitle: Companion to The Scorecard
promotionalText: Playing with your caddie? Let them do the scoring and let the gang follow live. Every card posts straight to The Scorecard: handicaps, games and rankings.
description:
Playing with your caddie? Let them do the scoring and let the gang follow live. See the group on your Apple Watch. The Marker is a hole-by-hole golf scorecard for one to four golfers. No account is needed to keep score: open it, choose a course and tee off. Games, caddie scoring and live following need a membership in a golf group on The Scorecard; your caddie and followers need no account.

SCORE YOUR WAY
- Enter all four golfers on one screen, or one golfer at a time.
- 18 holes, front nine or back nine, starting on any hole.
- Running totals, Out, In and score to par for every golfer.
- A golfer who arrives late can be added on any hole.
- Fix a score before you finish.

PLAY A GAME
- Start a game in The Marker, or join one with its six-number code.
- Every foursome in the game keeps its own card.
- A live leaderboard for the whole game; the final tally shows gross and net.

LET A CADDIE KEEP THE CARD
- Your caddie joins on their own phone with a short code, or by pointing the camera at a square code.
- Hand the card over before tee-off, or on any hole from the Menu.
- The caddie enters the scores; you check the card and finish it.

LET OTHERS FOLLOW LIVE
- Share a six-number code, and friends and family follow one card or the whole game as scores come in.
- Followers can only look; nothing can be changed.

YOUR GROUP ON YOUR APPLE WATCH
- Tap Send to my watch on the iPhone, or type the follow code on the watch.
- See all four golfers on the current hole, swipe through each golfer, and turn the Digital Crown to look back at earlier holes.
- Follow a game's leaderboard on your wrist.
- Add your score to your watch face, or the whole group to the Smart Stack.

COURSES
- Search for your course online, or enter one yourself.
- Take a picture of the club's scorecard and The Marker reads the holes, pars and yardages for you to check.

SHARE THE CARD
- Send the finished card by WhatsApp, email or text message.

No ads. No tracking.

BETTER TOGETHER WITH THE SCORECARD
The Marker works on its own as a simple, easy-to-read scorecard. Pair it with The Scorecard and every card you post updates each golfer's handicap index, your group's games and monthly rankings automatically. Games, caddie scoring and live following are for members of a Scorecard group.
whatsNew:
NEW LOOK
- A fresh Lake blue design and a new icon, matching The Scorecard.

PLAY A GAME IN THE MARKER
- Start or join a game right here, with a six-number code. No need to open The Scorecard.
- A Game button on every hole shows which game the card is in.
- Follow the whole game: a live leaderboard across every card, with gross and net at the end. On the Apple Watch too.

CADDIES AND FOLLOWERS
- Let my caddie score is easier to find, and works on any hole from the Menu.
- Follow codes are now six numbers, easy to type, even on the watch.
- No app yet? After installing from the caddie or follow link, The Marker picks up the code by itself.

LATE ARRIVALS
- Add a golfer after tee-off. With 14 or more holes played, the round still counts for their handicap (missed holes count as net par).
reviewNotes:
Thank you for reviewing The Marker 1.1.0. New in this version: a new look and icon, games started and joined in The Marker, following a whole game, a caddie taking over on any hole, six-number follow codes that can be typed on the Apple Watch, and adding a golfer after tee-off.

Scoring a round needs no sign-in: on the first screen, tap Play without an account, then Start a new round. Choose a course and tee, tap Choose the players, add up to four names, then tap Tee off on hole 1. Tap a number to enter each golfer's strokes.

Games, following and caddie scoring are for members of a golf group, so please use the sign-in in the Sign-in information section: tap Sign in with The Scorecard and enter that email and password.

Games: during a round, tap No game at the top of the hole, then Start a game. A six-number code appears. A second scorer taps No game and types the code to join. Menu, then See the leaderboard, shows every card in the game.

Follow: tap Menu, then Let others follow this card. A six-number code and a square code appear. On a second device, open The Marker (no sign-in needed), tap Follow at the bottom of the first screen and type the code. The card or the game's leaderboard fills in read-only as scores are entered.

Caddie scoring: tap Let my caddie score on Who's playing?, or in the Menu on any hole. On a second device, open The Marker (no sign-in needed), tap Caddie and type the code. The caddie enters the scores.

Apple Watch: with a paired Apple Watch, tap Send to my watch on the follow screen, or on the watch tap Type a follow code and enter the six numbers. The watch shows the group, each golfer, a summary, or a game's leaderboard; its widgets show the score on the watch face and in the Smart Stack.

The attached video shows following, caddie scoring and the watch on real devices.

The camera and photo library are used only when the golfer chooses to read a club scorecard from a picture. Before the first picture is sent to Cloudflare's AI for reading, the app asks for permission; the picture is not kept.

The Scorecard is a separate golf handicap app by the same developer. Members can post finished rounds to their group from The Marker.
